problem.title: Minimum Swaps to Sort By Digit Sum

approaches.title: Count mismatched positions
approaches.summary: Sort the values by digit sum, then estimate swaps as half the number of positions that differ from the sorted order. This does not correctly account for arbitrary permutation cycles.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Sorts by digit sum and returns half the count of mismatched positions; marked wrong.

approaches.title: Count permutation cycles
approaches.summary: Sort indexed values by digit sum and value, then map each sorted position to its original index. Count permutation cycles and return the minimum swaps as the array length minus the number of cycles.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Adds value-based tie-breaking and counts permutation cycles to compute the minimum swaps.
